doc.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Closing remarks
summary: Rowe thanks Alley, noting that fellows like him have human stories to tell.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: That’s all right. Well Tim can we get — well this has really been fascinating talking to you.
Well I hope you got something out of it.
I’m so glad that you were able to come.
Because I didn’t travel like these other guys.
That’s all right. You know it’s not just the really, really big name people who have the stories, it’s fellas like yourself, they don’t get to tell it as much and I’m pleased that you were able to.
That’s right. So thank you very much. © Fillius Jazz Archive -22-
